sources.entry: plotly - Interactive graphing library for Python.

summary.one_liner: plotly.py is an open-source, browser-based interactive graphing library for Python that builds charts on top of plotly.js.
summary.what_it_does: Provides two Python APIs for making interactive charts: graph objects (plotly.graph_objects) for low-level figure construction and Plotly Express (plotly.express) for high-level one-call charts. Figures can be shown in Jupyter notebooks, other notebook software such as marimo, saved as standalone HTML files, or embedded in Dash applications. The README says plotly.js ships with over 30 chart types, including scientific, 3D, statistical, SVG map, and financial charts. Static image export is available through the separate kaleido package. The README also mentions Jupyter widget support via anywidget.
notable: Two APIs: graph objects for fine control and Plotly Express for quick charts
Built on plotly.js with over 30 chart types
Outputs to Jupyter, marimo, standalone HTML, or Dash apps
caveats: Static image export requires Chrome or Chromium, which Kaleido uses from the system or installs with plotly_get_chrome
Plotly Express needs a supported dataframe library installed separately
Jupyter widget support requires extra packages (jupyter and anywidget)
keywords: make a chart from a dataframe
